name: Hamori Tsubasa
source:
A member of the idol unit merry-melody, also known as merymelo for short. As a result of being raised in an idol-training facility, she approaches things in a militaristic manner. She plays the role of a brown-nosing underclassman, a far cry from her great ambitions. She calls her fellow merry-melody member [url=/c98249]Kotori[/url] "Kotorin".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
